title: Removable
summary: REMOVABLE, adjective [from remove.] 1. That may be removed from an office or station. Such curate is removable at the pleasure of the rector of the mother church. 2. That may be removed from one place

inlines.v: REMOVABLE, adjective [from remove.] 1. That may be removed from an office or station. Such curate is removable at the pleasure of the rector of the mother church. 2. That may be removed from one place to another.
